cooling_type.quote: It uses a passive heat sink for cooling, which requires system air flow to properly operate the card within its thermal limits.

ecc_default.quote: Tesla P100 PCIe boards are shipped with ECC enabled by default to protect the GPU’s memory interface and the on-board memories.

ecc_capacity_or_bandwidth_overhead.quote: The Tesla P100 PCIe with HBM2 memory has native support for ECC and has no ECC overhead, both in memory capacity and bandwidth.

boost_behaviour.quote: By adjusting the GPU clock dynamically, maximum performance is achieved within the power cap limit.
